business_summary: Hangzhou Advance Gearbox Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and sells transmission and powder metallurgical products in China and internationally. The company offers marine products comprising marine gearboxes, hydraulic clutches, clutch gearboxes, controllable pitch propellers, fixed pitch propellers, tunnel thrusters, and azimuth thrusters; marine propulsion complete system products consisting of controllable pitch propellers, fixed pitch propellers, tunnel thrusters, and azimuth thrusters; wind turbine gearboxes; and construction transmission products, such as transmissions, torque converters, axles, transfer cases, and other transmission devices. It also provides automotive transmissions; industrial transmission products, including general industrial gearboxes, heavy-duty gearboxes, high-speed gearboxes, custom non-standard gearboxes, and system assemblies; agricultural transmissions; construction machinery gearboxes; wind turbine speed increasers; agricultural machinery gearboxes; rail transit drivetrains; and special products. In addition, the company offers high-precision parts and components, such as copper-based, iron-based, paper-based, and carbon-based friction materials, as well as high-strength powder metallurgy structural components. Further, it engages in the provision of engineering machinery transmissions, wind power gearboxes, friction plates, large-scale precision gears, highway and off-highway axles, clutches, couplings, motors, powder metallurgy parts, precision gears, and machinery equipment; technology development and technical services; sale of diesel engines and lubricating oils; warehousing services; and import and export activities. The company sells its products under the ADVANCE brand. It exports its products to Southeast Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. Hangzhou Advance Gearbox Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Hangzhou Advance Gearbox Group Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 해외에서 변속기 및 분말 야금 제품을 설계, 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 해양 기어박스, 유압 클러치, 클러치 기어박스, 제어 가능한 피치 프로펠러, 고정 피치 프로펠러, 터널 스러스터 및 방위각 스러스터로 구성된 해양 제품을 제공합니다. 제어 가능한 피치 프로펠러, 고정 피치 프로펠러, 터널 스러스터 및 방위각 스러스터로 구성된 해양 추진 전체 시스템 제품; 풍력 터빈 기어박스; 변속기, 토크 컨버터, 차축, 트랜스퍼 케이스 및 기타 변속기 장치와 같은 건설용 변속기 제품이 있습니다. 또한 자동차 변속기도 제공합니다. 일반 산업용 기어박스, 대형 기어박스, 고속 기어박스, 맞춤형 비표준 기어박스 및 시스템 어셈블리를 포함한 산업용 변속기 제품; 농업용 전송; 건설 기계 기어박스; 풍력 터빈 속도 증가기; 농업 기계 기어박스; 철도 운송 구동계; 그리고 특별한 제품. 또한 구리 기반, 철 기반, 종이 기반 등 고정밀 부품 및 부품을 제공합니다.
